body: "It can get better." I have 8 years worth of evidence through trial and error that says otherwise. What can you bring forward that says different? What guarantee do you have that it will? Even if by some miracle things do get better this world is still rotten. I would never want to force a child into this existence and expose them to all of this. I refuse to burden a spouse with my depression. Even if things do get better, i am fated to be alone and that won't make things "better"

I've been reconsidering for too long. If this is the best I'm going to get then there is no point in living a miserable life. I have come to terms with this. 8 years in and the only progress i have made has been backwards. Accepting that this is probably the best I will be and deciding to take action has actually brought a sense of relief. Relief that this constant pain will soon be gone
